practices.how_found: LangGraph checkpointer persist small state in DocumentDB guidance

practices.practice: When deploying to Azure, use role assignments and Key Vault RBAC properly so managed identities can access CMKs and Key Vaults; misconfiguring Key Vault network rules or RBAC can make CMK-enabled clusters inaccessible.
practices.source_name: Troubleshooting data encryption with customer-managed key (CMK) in Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: CMK key vault permissions managed identity azure documentdb troubleshooting

practices.practice: When building RAG pipelines, follow sample code for embedding generation and index creation to ensure consistent dimensionality, similarity function and index configuration.
practices.source_name: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: RAG pipeline sample embed create index azure documentdb

practices.practice: When you need to detect index-related regressions, run explain() before and after index changes and observe totalKeysExamined/totalDocsExamined to validate selectivity.
practices.source_name: Read query explain output in Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: use explain metrics totalKeysExamined totalDocsExamined detect regressions

practices.practice: When embedding models evolve, re-evaluate index choice and parameters because new model dimensions or normalization properties may change optimal settings.
practices.source_name: Quickstart: Vector index with TypeScript in Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: embeddings evolve change index parameters choose DiskANN HNSW IVF accordingly

practices.practice: When embedding storage is large, use compression or product quantization options offered by the service (when supported) to reduce memory footprint for the vector index.
practices.source_name: Integrated vector store in Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: vector index product quantization compression reduce memory footprint azure documentdb

practices.practice: When performing sensitive-data operations, ensure diagnostic logs and monitoring do not leak secrets (redact sensitive fields) and secure diagnostic destinations (Log Analytics workspace).
practices.source_name: Secure your Azure DocumentDB cluster
practices.how_found: diagnostic logging security redact secrets configure log analytics azure documentdb
